__broaden__.ὄρινε: ὀρίνω — stir up, rouse; impf./aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ὤρινε): ’stirred’ · ὀρίνω — pres. imper. 2 sg. act.: ’stir up!’
__broaden__.ἵει: ἵημι — send, let go, throw; impf. 3 sg.: ’sent’ · also ἵημι — put, set; impf. 3 sg., with ἐν: ’put in’ (ἐν … ἵει ’put in (the traces)’) · ἵημι — send, hurl; pres. imper. 2 sg. act., with ἐν in tmesis: ’hurl in, let loose’
__broaden__.κήδειν: κήδω — distress, trouble, vex; pres. inf. act., after καλόν: ’to distress’ · κήδω — pres. inf. act., of purpose after a verb of attacking: ’to harm’
__broaden__.μυρίον: μυρίος — countless, boundless; adj., neut. nom. sg., agreeing with πένθος: ’boundless (grief)’ · μυρίος — countless; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with χέραδος: ’countless (gravel)’
__broaden__.θύων: θύω — rush, rage, surge (of wind; not θύω ’sacrifice’); pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’raging’ · also of a river in spate: ’raging’ (κυκώμενος ὑψόσε θύων ’churning, raging high’)
